## Validation

- [ ] Repository validation
- [ ] Differential Change Set validation
- [ ] Unit and representative behavioral tests
- [ ] Deterministic failures interpreted, corrected, and the same checks rerun successfully
- [ ] Skill and reference synchronization reviewed
- [ ] Examples, templates, and manifests reviewed

## Release readiness

- Proposed release class: `<none|patch|minor|major>`
- [ ] Changelog updated when notable
- [ ] Upgrade or migration guidance updated when required
- [ ] Conformance and audit impact reviewed
- [ ] No release tag created or moved before the release gate and explicit approval
- [ ] If tag creation must be handed to a human, the exact tag, branch, commit, title, changelog-derived description, and remaining approval are ready only after all gates pass
